title: Conquest of the wind
description:
An RPG modpack with only just a 100 mods inside

Download now free:)
body: Conquest of the Wind is a lightweight yet immersive RPG-focused Minecraft modpack designed with only 100 carefully selected mods. It emphasizes exploration, vertical movement, and skill-based combat, where wind, terrain, and discovery shape your journey. Travel through vast landscapes, conquer dungeons, battle powerful foes, and grow your character through meaningful progression without overwhelming systems or heavy technology.
